Name: MISSION_SYS_MSG_COMMON_PARAM_ST
Description: Common mission system messages: up to five lines (Talk Param IDs), each played when its event flag condition is met, with a priority, display limit and minimum interval.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: 0: Playback Condition Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be set for Talk Param ID [0] to play.

Fields.Name: 1: Playback Condition Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be set for Talk Param ID [1] to play.

Fields.Name: 2: Playback Condition Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be set for Talk Param ID [2] to play.

Fields.Name: 3: Playback Condition Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be set for Talk Param ID [3] to play.

Fields.Name: 4: Playback Condition Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be set for Talk Param ID [4] to play.

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Message priority. Lower values take priority.

Fields.Name: Message Display Limit
Fields.Description: Maximum number of times the message is shown.

Fields.Name: Minimum Message Interval
Fields.Description: Minimum time between showings of the message. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Exchange Message Category ID
Fields.Description: Category ID of the exchange (back-and-forth) message that follows. -1: no exchange.
